_doc: The WS-A scoped, pre-register workspace boot token. An ordinary workspace box
no longer carries the tenant admin_token (least privilege, founder ruling
2026-07-08); it authenticates its two PRE-register operations — boot-event
phone-home and object-store platform-proxy restore-on-boot — with THIS token.
Opaque stateless HMAC bearer keyed on the per-tenant admin_token (HMAC key
ONLY, never transmitted → conveys no admin power). The CP mints it; the CP
(boot-event) and molecule-core (restore route) verify it offline against the
same per-tenant key. The test_vectors are the anti-drift anchor: the minter
(molecule-controlplane internal/boottoken) and BOTH verifiers must reproduce

construction.signing_input: the base64url-encoded payload string (the part before the dot)
construction.payload_encoding: compact UTF-8 JSON of the claims object, fields in the order wsid, org, exp, scope

claims.wsid: workspace id the token is bound to
claims.org: org id the token is bound to (must match the presented org header on boot-event)
claims.exp: expiry, unix seconds; verifier rejects when now > exp
